name: vigil-safety-companion
description: VIGIL - AI-Assisted Virtual Safety Companion (Team BUG BUSTERS)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), {execSync}=require('child_process'); const root = (!fs.existsSync('backend') && fs.existsSync('../backend')) ? '..' : '.'; execSync('npm --prefix ' + root + '/backend install && npm --prefix ' + root + '/frontend install && npm --prefix ' + root + '/frontend run build', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.vercel-build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), {execSync}=require('child_process'); const root = (!fs.existsSync('backend') && fs.existsSync('../backend')) ? '..' : '.'; execSync('npm --prefix ' + root + '/backend install && npm --prefix ' + root + '/frontend install && npm --prefix ' + root + '/frontend run build', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
